defmodule FileProcessor do
  @moduledoc """
  File processing service with audit logging.
  Processes uploaded files and maintains an audit trail.
  """

  use GenServer

  @max_filename_length 255
  @max_chunk_size 65_536
  @audit_buffer_capacity 1024

  defstruct [:audit_buffer, :buffer_pos, :processing_state, :config]

  # Client API

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def process_file(path, metadata) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:process_file, path, metadata})
  end

  def get_audit_log do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_audit_log)
  end

  # Server callbacks

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    config = %{
      max_file_size: Keyword.get(opts, :max_file_size, 10_485_760),
      allowed_extensions: Keyword.get(opts, :allowed_extensions, [".txt", ".csv", ".json"]),
      audit_level: Keyword.get(opts, :audit_level, :standard)
    }

    state = %__MODULE__{
      audit_buffer: :binary.copy(<<0>>, @audit_buffer_capacity),
      buffer_pos: 0,
      processing_state: :idle,
      config: config
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:process_file, path, metadata}, _from, state) do
    with :ok <- validate_path(path, state.config),
         :ok <- validate_metadata(metadata),
         {:ok, new_state} <- write_audit_entry(state, :file_received, path, metadata),
         {:ok, content} <- read_file_safe(path, state.config),
         {:ok, result} <- transform_content(content, metadata),
         {:ok, final_state} <- write_audit_entry(new_state, :file_processed, path, %{size: byte_size(result)}) do
      {:reply, {:ok, result}, final_state}
    else
      {:error, reason} = err ->
        {_, error_state} = write_audit_entry(state, :error, path, %{reason: reason})
        {:reply, err, error_state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_audit_log, _from, state) do
    log = :binary.part(state.audit_buffer, 0, state.buffer_pos)
    {:reply, {:ok, log}, state}
  end

  # Private functions

  defp validate_path(path, config) do
    cond do
      String.length(path) > @max_filename_length ->
        {:error, :filename_too_long}

      String.contains?(path, "..") ->
        {:error, :path_traversal}

      not Enum.any?(config.allowed_extensions, &String.ends_with?(path, &1)) ->
        {:error, :invalid_extension}

      true ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp validate_metadata(metadata) when is_map(metadata) do
    required_keys = [:user_id, :timestamp, :operation]

    if Enum.all?(required_keys, &Map.has_key?(metadata, &1)) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_metadata}
    end
  end

  defp validate_metadata(_), do: {:error, :invalid_metadata}

  defp write_audit_entry(state, event_type, path, details) do
    entry = format_audit_entry(event_type, path, details)
    entry_bytes = entry <> <<0>>
    entry_size = byte_size(entry_bytes)

    available_space = compute_available_space(state)

    if entry_size <= available_space do
      new_buffer = write_to_buffer(state.audit_buffer, state.buffer_pos, entry_bytes)
      new_state = %{state | audit_buffer: new_buffer, buffer_pos: state.buffer_pos + entry_size}
      {:ok, new_state}
    else
      # Compact buffer by removing oldest entries to make space
      compacted_state = compact_audit_buffer(state, entry_size)
      new_buffer = write_to_buffer(compacted_state.audit_buffer, compacted_state.buffer_pos, entry_bytes)
      new_state = %{compacted_state | audit_buffer: new_buffer, buffer_pos: compacted_state.buffer_pos + entry_size}
      {:ok, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp compute_available_space(state) do
    # Calculate remaining space in the audit buffer
    # Uses signed arithmetic for the difference
    total = byte_size(state.audit_buffer)
    used = state.buffer_pos
    total - used
  end

  defp compact_audit_buffer(state, needed_size) do
    buffer = state.audit_buffer
    pos = state.buffer_pos

    # Find the first null terminator after the midpoint to preserve recent entries
    midpoint = div(pos, 2)
    scan_start = find_next_null(buffer, midpoint)
    keep_start = scan_start + 1

    kept_data = :binary.part(buffer, keep_start, pos - keep_start)
    kept_size = byte_size(kept_data)

    # Rebuild buffer with kept data
    new_capacity = max(@audit_buffer_capacity, kept_size + needed_size)
    new_buffer = kept_data <> :binary.copy(<<0>>, new_capacity - kept_size)

    %{state | audit_buffer: new_buffer, buffer_pos: kept_size}
  end

  defp find_next_null(buffer, offset) do
    case :binary.match(buffer, <<0>>, scope: {offset, byte_size(buffer) - offset}) do
      {pos, _} -> pos
      :nomatch -> offset
    end
  end

  defp write_to_buffer(buffer, offset, data) do
    prefix = :binary.part(buffer, 0, offset)
    suffix_start = offset + byte_size(data)
    suffix_len = byte_size(buffer) - suffix_start

    if suffix_len > 0 do
      suffix = :binary.part(buffer, suffix_start, suffix_len)
      prefix <> data <> suffix
    else
      prefix <> data
    end
  end

  defp format_audit_entry(event_type, path, details) do
    timestamp = System.system_time(:millisecond)
    details_str = inspect(details, limit: :infinity)

    # Format: [timestamp]|event_type|path|details
    "[#{timestamp}]|#{event_type}|#{path}|#{details_str}"
  end

  defp read_file_safe(path, config) do
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %{size: size}} when size <= config.max_file_size ->
        File.read(path)

      {:ok, %{size: _}} ->
        {:error, :file_too_large}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp transform_content(content, metadata) do
    operation = Map.get(metadata, :operation, :identity)

    case operation do
      :identity -> {:ok, content}
      :upcase -> {:ok, String.upcase(content)}
      :compress -> {:ok, :zlib.compress(content)}
      :chunk -> chunk_content(content)
      _ -> {:error, :unknown_operation}
    end
  end

  defp chunk_content(content) do
    chunks =
      content
      |> :binary.bin_to_list()
      |> Enum.chunk_every(@max_chunk_size)
      |> Enum.map(&:binary.list_to_bin/1)

    {:ok, chunks}
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.NIF do
  @moduledoc """
  NIF bindings for high-performance buffer operations.
  Falls back to pure Elixir if NIF is unavailable.
  """

  @on_load :load_nif

  def load_nif do
    path = Application.app_dir(:file_processor, "priv/file_processor_nif")
    :erlang.load_nif(String.to_charlist(path), 0)
  rescue
    _ -> :ok
  end

  @doc """
  Fast buffer write using NIF. Falls back to binary operations.
  The NIF version uses memcpy without bounds checking for performance.
  Buffer overflow occurs when entry_size exceeds actual remaining capacity
  but compute_available_space returns a stale/incorrect value due to
  the compact operation resizing the buffer.
  """
  def nif_buffer_write(_buffer, _offset, _data) do
    # NIF not loaded, this is the fallback
    :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  end
end
